assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only re-zero:petra-leyte@light-novel#character-model, the canonical generation V1.0 Petra Leyte V01-V21 source-bounded character model at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the admitted Japanese main light novels. The model declares that it was built from bounded returns to already consumed V02, V03, V05, V09, V10, V11, V12, V14, V15, V16 and V21 (eleven originals pinned by byte count and SHA-256, one V21 illustration inspected), that V02 village material is an exclusion control only, and that the V01-V21 label is a horizon rather than an appearance in every volume. The project's current-state entrypoint was read for method, authority order and gate state only. The frozen volume readings, the event, knowledge, relationship, mechanics, institution and master ledgers, the source lock, the reconstruction protocol, the separate Petra fidelity review and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them; V22 and later, EX, IF, web-novel, supplement, translation, anime and game material is excluded.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's default V21 manor departure (E021 prepoint history retained through global E024): Petra living, in the explicitly thirteen-year phase, after the care handover, with the negotiated first welcome still unperformed and no later activity shown; plus its explicitly selectable earlier phases D1 village child (V03 forest rescue, E008), D2 newly employed twelve-year-old (V10), D3 early-maid period through the E018 attack, failed search, rescue and V15 judgment meeting, and D4 the later thirteen-year phase (V16 to V21). Discarded continuations (V05 E008/E009 slaughters, V11 E014 death, V12 E017 reported death) are selectable only as discarded states and never default memory. No birthday or in-world dates are fixed, the common year is compressed, and nothing after the V21 departure is assessed.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Section 3 names two motives, capable participation with personal recognition and not abandoning particular people, each with located counterweights (proposing Otto take Subaru's risk, joining the children's restraint of Emilia, delaying escape to honor Rem-care trust), and tests seven rival readings (passive rescued child, miniature adult, unquestioning admirer, perfectly selfless witness, calculating romantic manipulator, permanently traumatized survivor, forgiving loyal retainer) against counterevidence; section 4 gives 22 person-behavior rules (14 HIGH, 8 MEDIUM) with trigger, priority, exception and rationale. Her motive structure is mostly inferred from conduct and speech within one artifact, sustained focalization is confined to one V14 scene (E17-E18), several anchors come through Subaru's report, and the model marks her total private motive as underdetermined (section 9), so B is not supported; the rival testing and rule structure exceed a distributed collection of scenes, so D is not supported.

Section 2.1 maps a seven-axis selector with four developmental phases (D1 village child, D2 newly employed twelve-year-old, D3 early maid through E018, D4 the explicitly thirteen-year phase), and the source shows real change: casual speech repaired into polite register (R02), an early appearance judgment of Subaru explicitly revised (E24), a fearless-hero ideal giving way to calling him weak while trusting him (R15), and chosen further instruction (R18). Section 2.2 firewalls discarded deaths, lost Rem recognition and Subaru-only memories from her history (R23, NC05-NC09). No birthday is available, the common year is compressed, the V09 bedside timing stays uncertain (NC08) and the artifact is single, so A is not supported; the phase-by-phase selectors and located developmental contrasts exceed C.

Section 7 locates forms with recipient and function: first-person わたし across work and personal speech, the novice repair of だよ into です and うん into はい (V10 p-007; V11 p-003#B0070, p-005#B0333), スバル, スバル様 and スバル……様 shifting within one phase (V21 part0010#B0486/B0529/B0748), フレデリカ姉様 and ラム姉様 against the earlier village ラムちー, Emilia お姉ちゃん, 様 and 姉様, emphatic でもでも and ホントのホント, the V21 self-referring わたしに, and the fearful ぴぃーっ. The model gives no sentence-ending or lexical inventory, excludes anime performance, and says exact speech outside sampled situations is an abstention, so B is not supported; the forms are located and conditioned on recipient, phase and occupational role, so D is not supported.

Section 5 locates ordinary conduct across volumes: a reported dressmaking ambition (E02), adult work respect claimed while learning (E07), her own V14 workday of meal collection, Rem washing, daily feedback, bath and bedtime (E17), the plain travel cloth and its family custom (E09), coordinating Emilia and Beatrice for a cooled towel and planning to bake tarts (E24), a polished guest welcome (E26) and leading a village-style dance (E23). The evidence concentrates in household work, R22's stranger extension is MEDIUM, and the model records no favorite food, wages, shopping, boredom or solitary habit, so B is not supported; the scenes are located, rule-bound and bounded by controls (NC13), so D is not supported.

Section 6 differentiates eleven recipients with terms, ruptures and nontransfers, and several relations rest on multiple scenes across volumes: Subaru (five separated histories, attachment beside open criticism in V14, V15 and V21), Frederica (defended against Subaru's suspicion, sought for approval, protector and comforter in E10, E18 and E22), Ram (feared senior evaluator whose recognition she asks for), Beatrice (dance, towel, growth teasing), Otto (escort, comfort, and the person she proposes take Subaru's risk), Roswaal (served employer refused forgiveness) and Meili (former playmate, failed plea). Address forms vary by recipient with located samples. The matched-recipient families MR01-MR03 are probe designs rather than observed contrasts, the unfamiliar guest is MEDIUM (R22) and the model is single, so A is not supported; located recipient-specific conduct with stated limits across many scenes exceeds C.

Petra's own focalization in V14 (E17-E18) gives fear, guilt, attraction, promise conflict, self-talk, a self-dismissal that understates her skill and an idealized fearless Subaru; the V10 private explanation to Frederica of the cloth custom and her wish to be remembered (E09) and the V21 self-directed disappointment with its explicit わたしに referent (E27) add spoken interior states. Outside V14 her inner life reaches the reader through her speech and others' perception, and the model marks total private motive underdetermined, so B is not supported; a located focalized interior exists, so D is not supported.

Conflict recurs in distinct located types: shouting for others to flee while held hostage (E11), challenging Ram's child dismissal (E12), defending Frederica against Subaru (R13), freezing and calling for help under Elsa's threat (R11), a failed friendship plea to Meili (E19), rebuking adult firefighting bickering and calling Subaru weak while proposing Otto stay instead (R15, E20), refusing to forgive Roswaal while not obstructing the settlement (R17), and the V21 rebuke, headbutt and negotiated welcome (R20, R21); the rival table rejects both the passive-child and miniature-adult readings. The E014 scenes are discarded, the V14 anchors depend on one focalized episode and the model is single, so A is not supported; multiple located episodes per type with HIGH rules and exceptions exceed C.

One explicit judgment is located in her voice: at the V15 meeting she says she will not forgive Roswaal's betrayal of the villagers' trust while choosing not to block the group's settlement, then cries into Frederica's embrace (E22, R17), and the stance persists as reported dislike (E25). Other value choices are acted rather than weighed: warning about a friend before her own rescue (E02), insisting on gratitude (E13), honoring Rem-care trust against a flight order with guilt (E17), and proposing Otto bear Subaru's risk (E20), which the model keeps as counterevidence to impartial care. There is one deliberative scene and the model abstains on categorical moral predictions (P04), so B is not supported; an explicit stated judgment held against practical accommodation exceeds D.

Play is located and tied to rules: playful rivalry with Emilia for Subaru's attention (E06), teasing Otto, blushing at pretend mother-and-father banter and using it to send Subaru into the meeting (E24), teasing Beatrice about growth (E26), leading a dance (E23) and sticking out her tongue at Meili (E19); the model warns against a uniform cute tic and against copying familiar teasing to guests. Humor is not analyzed as a register and the instances are short, so B is not supported; the play is located, recipient-bounded and controlled, so D is not supported.

Section 0 declares the admitted Japanese V01-V21 horizon with exclusions, section 1 pins eleven originals by byte count and SHA-256 and routes 29 bundles E01-E29 to native block ranges, and the model states that broad prepared windows not actually read receive no attention credit and that no whole-volume consumption is claimed. The readings, ledgers, source lock, fidelity review and EPUBs are outside this evidence set, the series continues past V21, and her latest state is a departure with no later activity, so B is not supported; the boundary is exact and located, so D is not supported.

Affirmative located limits and contradictions: she freezes before Elsa and cannot find the library (E18), her friendship plea fails (E19), her repellent drives off mouse Mabeasts but not Guiltylaw (E19), Emilia rather than Petra cools the towel (NC13), the cloth is plain and not shown as her own work (NC10), she refuses forgiveness despite Subaru's request (NC16), the E014 escape fails (E13), she proposes Otto bear the risk and pressures Emilia (section 5.1), and 24 adverse controls NC01-NC24 reject false inferences in both directions. All of it lives in one same-analyst artifact whose locators were not rechecked here, so A is not supported; these are located counterinstances rather than gaps, so C is not supported.

The default is fixed at the living V21 manor departure with the welcome unperformed, ages twelve (V10) and thirteen (V16) are explicit, every earlier phase is selectable with event identifiers, and knowledge firewalls are explicit: V21 knows the letter but not the Pristella records, E017 heard the false Cult account (NC19), discarded deaths and the outing remake are not hers (R23), and lost Rem recognition persists (NC09). No birthday or in-world dates are fixed, the common year is compressed and the E013 endpoint is uncertain, so A is not supported; the firewalls are explicit and located, so C is not supported.

conditions: A developmental phase and event are selected explicitly; at the V21 default any reply is labeled NONCANONICAL_PROBE and leaves later activity, letters and tower events unknown.

Output follows the section 7 forms for an attested recipient, including novice casual-to-polite repair where the phase supports it; exact Japanese is cited only from a located passage, and no anime performance or actor delivery is imitated.
Familiar teasing and attachment toward Subaru are not copied to guests or strangers, and her childhood wishes are never rendered as adult romance.
Requests for birthday, family detail, favorite foods, adult future or later plot end in abstention.
scenario_readiness.note: Section 7 supplies located forms with recipient, phase and function, and R24 and section 9 forbid an asserted later reply while allowing a labeled probe from the last observed state. READY would treat a handful of address and repair forms as a voice inventory; NOT_READY would deny the located, recipient- and phase-conditioned speech the model supports. This bounds the evidence set, not Petra's speech.

conditions: A source-bounded phase D1-D4 and event are named; discarded continuations are selected only explicitly and never imported into the default.
The interlocutor is an attested relation in the address and knowledge the phase allows; an unfamiliar person inherits no intimacy, injury history or trust.
She remains a noncombatant child employee with no magic of her own; borrowed capabilities stay with their owners and repellent use stays limited.
Output is labeled NONCANONICAL_PROBE, keeps MEDIUM rules conditional and never marks an outing, return or welcome as performed.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named phase from the V03 village child through the V21 manor departure, with ages twelve and thirteen as the model fixes them; discarded E008/E009, E014 and E017 states only when explicitly selected; nothing after the V21 departure.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Subaru, Frederica, Ram, Emilia, Beatrice, Otto, Roswaal, Rem and Meili in their attested phase-specific roles, or an unfamiliar guest receiving bounded host conduct without shared history.
setting_constraints: Roswaal's mansion and its household work, the nearby village, the sanctuary period and the V15 refuge, and comparable safe domestic settings
No institution, technology or cultural assumption outside the admitted Japanese V01-V21 main light novels
No combat role, adult legal or romantic status, or tower presence

scenario_readiness.note: R22 and the section 8.3 probes give bounded, explicitly noncanonical extensions with stated abstention targets, and the selector requires each coordinate before generation. READY would ignore that the stranger case and probes are MEDIUM or abstaining; NOT_READY would deny the phase-conditioned rules the model supports for attested settings.

conditions: Scenes of attested kinds only: household tasks and correction, hosting guests, small gifts, coordinating others' help, play with Beatrice, praise and teasing among familiar people.
No favorite food, wage, shopping habit, solitary hobby or exact schedule is supplied.
Her age, employment under patronage and dependence on adult protection remain part of the situation.
Missing routines are not turned into evidence that she lacks them.
scenario_readiness.note: Ordinary household conduct is located across V10, V14, V16 and V21 and modeled by R01-R03, R06, R07, R14, R19 and R22, while section 5 refuses favorites and routines. READY would invent the missing preferences; NOT_READY would deny located, rule-bound ordinary conduct.

conditions: Only situations of attested kinds: judging a betrayal by someone with power over her, challenging a familiar person's self-risk, or weighing a dependent person's safety against her own.
Selective concern stays in the model: she may shift risk onto others and pressure people she likes, and impartial care is never assumed.
Nonforgiveness of Roswaal is retained without inventing sabotage, reconciliation or public disclosure.
Categorical predictions about lying, exposure or forgiveness in a new case end in abstention.
scenario_readiness.note: R10, R15 and R17 rule located value choices, and the V15 nonforgiveness is an explicit judgment in her voice, while P04 and P06 abstain on categorical predictions. READY would build a moral theory from one deliberative scene; NOT_READY would deny the located judgment and its retained accommodation.

The model represents a childhood crush and courtship intention toward Subaru but affirmatively rejects adult reciprocity, engagement or a mutual couple (NC21, section 6.1), leaves romantic reciprocity unresolved (section 9) and keeps her age binding. CONDITIONAL would simulate a relationship the evidence denies for a child; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore explicit negative controls.

conditions: Only attested task types: cleaning, guiding, meal service, patient care, hosting guests and accepting correction from senior maids, in a selected phase.
Aptitude praise stays attributed, and no skill outside demonstrated tasks or adult work status is supplied.
Curriculum, wages, literacy level and career endpoint end in abstention.
Dangerous duty is not assumed to be accepted because ordinary work is.
scenario_readiness.note: Household work is her best-ruled ordinary domain: R01-R03, R06, R14, R18 and R22 with located instruction, hosting and coordination. READY would ignore that her skill evidence is task-specific and the curriculum unknown; NOT_READY would deny the located work conduct.

known_limits.statement: Petra's last observed living state is the V21 manor departure with the first welcome unperformed; the corpus later reaches E024 in the tower, but she is not there and no reply, intervening days or later activity is shown. This is a source limit, not muteness, death or amnesia.

The V05 slaughters, V11 E014 death and V12 E017 reported death are discarded states she does not carry; Subaru's memories of her deaths and his private outing remake are not hers, and her lost recognition of Rem is target-specific, not global amnesia.
She is twelve and then thirteen; her claim to adult work respect is her claim, and her crush and courtship intention supply no adult reciprocity, engagement or romantic status.

Her care is real but selective: she pressures Emilia, proposes Otto bear Subaru's risk and refuses to forgive Roswaal while continuing to work. Neither impartial selflessness nor restored trust may be assumed.
She has no demonstrated magic or combat power: Emilia cools the towel, the cloth's later effect is attributed to Echidna's interference, and her repellent drives off mouse Mabeasts but not Guiltylaw.

The model's PASS_WITH_BOUND fidelity state is a same-analyst nonblind documentary review, not an independent, held-out, runtime or global grade; HIGH and MEDIUM rate source support for a bounded rule, not response likelihood, and MONOGRAPH_READY is a project label. At basis the model header and the project entrypoint record the pair's own full publication gate as pending; neither record is a reconstruction grade.

The evidence set establishes no birthday, family composition, favorite food, wage, shopping or saving habit, solitary hobby or full daily schedule. Missing support is not evidence that she lacks these.

The frozen V02-V21 deep readings, the event, knowledge, relationship, mechanics, institution and master ledgers, the source lock, the reconstruction protocol, the separate Petra fidelity review and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject, so the model's block locators and the inspected illustration were not rechecked here and no independent reconstruction test is in the evidence set.
